conclusion: The 1024-slot cache reduced application reads from 5,897,650,176 to 4,512,153,600 bytes (-23.5%).
Read time rose from 16.62 s to 21.62 s and decode fell from 0.561 to 0.461 tok/s.
Peak RSS rose from 2,209,768 to 2,761,520 KiB because the arena grew by 566 MiB.
Keep demand reads and the small arena as the default; do not adopt a large global LRU from this evidence.
limits: One consecutive pair under uncontrolled page-cache and thermal state.
The routing trace shows a decode working set of 960 keys, so capacities below 960 cannot hit.
No per-tensor or prefetch policy was compared.
